title: Choate's Air Conditioning & Heating: 68 Years in Memphis, and the Giving Keeps Finding Them
summary: Brian Choate's family has run the same Memphis HVAC company for 68 years — and built a training house, partnered with trade colleges, and quietly donated everything from AC systems to Grizzlies tickets along the way.
